plugins.name: yolo-dag
plugins.description: Turns an ambiguous request into a reviewed, executed, integrated branch: /brainstorm asks whether this is a plan-only run or a full run, resolves ambiguity, then the orchestrator routes to the relevant specialists, runs per-specialist review loops, reconciles cross-specialist contradictions, and decomposes into independent tasks bound by shared contracts. A full run implements without asking again; a plan-only run stops at the implementation boundary and waits. Execution runs in user-paced passes — one question per pass, how many tasks in parallel, with the orchestrator choosing an independent set itself — merging each approved task onto one integration branch as its pass resolves, and closing with a whole-suite run and an acceptance review against the original request.
